summary: Tested public storefront, filtering, product navigation, demo checkout/download, Clerk routes, owner protection, responsive layout, and backend APIs. Backend regression suite passed 6/6; storefront detail and authenticated admin integration have unresolved issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating any product card to /product/{id} leaves the page stuck on loading because ProductPage reads regex groups from /product\/(.*) even though the regex defines no named group; id becomes undefined and the product request targets /api/products/undefined.

integration_issues.issue: Admin loads products/orders with axios calls that do not attach Clerk getToken() Authorization headers. Protected /api/admin/products and /api/admin/orders therefore return 401 even for a signed-in owner; dashboard data cannot load.

action_items: Fix ProductPage route parameter extraction (use useParams or a correctly named regex group) and retest product detail, buy, checkout, and success flows.
Use Clerk useAuth().getToken() (or an authenticated axios layer) for all admin product/order requests and retest the owner dashboard.
Implement or clearly disable the currently inert Add product and edit controls; backend admin CRUD exists but no frontend form is wired.
Keep DEMO-MODE checkout and generated text delivery clearly labeled; this is not a live Stripe payment or real uploaded-file delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin frontend protected API calls omit the bearer token, making the signed-in dashboard nonfunctional.
ProductPage uses pathname.match(/product\/(.*)/)?.groups despite no named capture group, guaranteeing an undefined product id.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; checkout regression created one TEST_ui@example.com demo order record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public products/detail APIs, demo checkout/status/download, unauthorized admin protection, Clerk config, signed-out owner wall, search/category filters, and mobile overflow were tested. Product detail UI is blocked by id parsing; authenticated owner dashboard was not completed because no credentials exist in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
test_credentials: No credentials were present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; authenticated owner flow was not automated.
rca of the issue: Product detail root cause is frontend-only: ProductPage destructures .groups from a regex without named groups, so id is undefined and the API lookup cannot return a product. Admin root cause is missing auth propagation: Admin uses bare axios requests despite protected backend routes requiring Clerk bearer tokens. Checkout and private delivery are intentionally MOCKED/DEMO-MODE per the approved constraints: checkout immediately creates a paid local order and downloads a generated text response instead of Stripe/object-storage content.
